verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains an Ironclad AI product page, but the only cited content is marketing taglines ('Built on how contracts really move', 'A New Era of Contract Intelligence'). Neither describes a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The API guide on running 'AI-driven analysis' via Workflow APIs is a developer building block for integrators, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
